description: NaP₇ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/acd space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ atoms to form distorted NaP₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaP₆ pentagonal pyramids and corners with eight PNaP₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.11 Å. There are four inequivalent P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ sites. In the first P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ atoms to form PNaP₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaP₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with seven PNaP₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PNa₂P₂ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.20 Å) and one longer (2.28 Å) P-P bond length. In the second P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ is bonded to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing PNa₂P₂ tetrahedra. Both P-P bond lengths are 2.19 Å. In the third P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ atoms to form PNaP₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaP₆ pentagonal pyramids and corners with nine PNaP₃ tetrahedra. Both P-P bond lengths are 2.20 Å. In the fourth P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three P⁰ᐧ¹⁴⁻ atoms.
